title: [Yaml] Negative integers are parsed as floating point values
body:
Tested against 2.1 branch. To demonstrate, modify `InlineTest.php` like so:

``` diff
diff --git a/src/Symfony/Component/Yaml/Tests/InlineTest.php b/src/Symfony/Component/Yaml/Tests/InlineTest.php
index 2684fa5..516de5d 100644
--- a/src/Symfony/Component/Yaml/Tests/InlineTest.php
+++ b/src/Symfony/Component/Yaml/Tests/InlineTest.php
@@ -19,7 +19,7 @@ class InlineTest extends \PHPUnit_Framework_TestCase
     public function testParse()
     {
         foreach ($this->getTestsForParse() as $yaml => $value) {
-            $this->assertEquals($value, Inline::parse($yaml), sprintf('::parse() converts an inline YAML to a PHP structure (%s)', $yaml));
+            $this->assertSame($value, Inline::parse($yaml), sprintf('::parse() converts an inline YAML to a PHP structure (%s)', $yaml));
         }
     }

@@ -108,6 +108,7 @@ class InlineTest extends \PHPUnit_Framework_TestCase
             'false' => false,
             'true' => true,
             '12' => 12,
+            '-12' => -12,
             '"quoted string"' => 'quoted string',
             "'quoted string'" => 'quoted string',
             '12.30e+02' => 12.30e+02,
@@ -117,7 +118,7 @@ class InlineTest extends \PHPUnit_Framework_TestCase
             '-.Inf' => log(0),
             "'686e444'" => '686e444',
             '686e444' => 646e444,
-            '123456789123456789' => '123456789123456789',
+            '123456789123456789123456789123456789' => '123456789123456789123456789123456789',
             '"foo\r\nbar"' => "foo\r\nbar",
             "'foo#bar'" => 'foo#bar',
             "'foo # bar'" => 'foo # bar',
```

I had to increase the size of the large integer also, otherwise the test fails on machines with 64-bit integer support.

Here's my patch, but I'll submit a PR shortly:

``` diff
diff --git a/src/Symfony/Component/Yaml/Inline.php b/src/Symfony/Component/Yaml/Inline.php
index df89285..679708a 100644
--- a/src/Symfony/Component/Yaml/Inline.php
+++ b/src/Symfony/Component/Yaml/Inline.php
@@ -379,6 +379,11 @@ class Inline
                 $cast = intval($scalar);

                 return '0' == $scalar[0] ? octdec($scalar) : (((string) $raw == (string) $cast) ? $cast : $raw);
+            case '-' === substr($scalar, 0, 1) && ctype_digit(substr($scalar, 1)):
+                $raw = $scalar;
+                $cast = intval($scalar);
+
+                return '0' == $scalar[1] ? octdec($scalar) : (((string) $raw == (string) $cast) ? $cast : $raw);
             case 'true' === strtolower($scalar):
                 return true;
             case 'false' === strtolower($scalar):
```
